The [NHS](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESiQEBxCJF18EpMviKuIXq4reR9u0u_a_Q_KFGYprpes2i0AUDB5Eskxvq4rRYTHPa9ybv5yqfPpTA7J2t18_2IhGhN1h1uB4LanrUjcD2U_Vemm9Gaw09af7Bn1dSukYMGM3-P0npvnxtw0BjKGgU5CUy4fxmvv_tH3VR2pFmvtW8fN1zBCBdH34owg) notes that while you can drink alcohol with azithromycin, you should avoid it if the medication makes you feel dizzy.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESiAEBxCJF1-FNY40WK5sb3zJPv_Jkf9adLYK2MQJ2_4ijwSc39KwXpge5lLSigyQfhpvkJUo5wmn3Y-H-Bm-_Bp8dJ-agvUzt7-a0FbZ6NaWuOhB9Q7JWoXE2KFsvlP6xB6vPTVuvAkb6Kh69oMmMEuLUSqX6sbqLip7zo0oyBmzqwp1mDpzsHDhM)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESqQEBxCJF19CA2Ui5mgj9siI58XAhMNsna7T7vxwjReMJUiVtWEdohCaAnmjQRtXLeCTFeoVubGJ2My7rCUvqxmVsHbuo1nkuNfNEA0PGpdlXyXsEiD66TopZkkK6gVUGUoqx8AKJOdfAo1ndepXBgHaceEKi9evQi8cM7iZ4z_QPGgfyb-1BLGs78wXHmfY9BMlH9nJzweRQf-e0O7S2TA1MW5wBMRKpg-tI)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESmgEBxCJF19FlZ30uGuD8WNX9Iku13pPpQHd9Wi0KndJc0DuvetJ-P8MEFEIj3WJSidp-Z8SAsyZnWaZkfIlDsnuLMokocJaNAg35oZzmQiYktYZ8MoM_calu_SI5tlm4vcGLw37VGKjM7wI8FixOon44gwEBayrk1WWT9kcvW1_pAUvnlN6uOtawbpw23Zp_e9xaodi3ksf5nY5I)[[4]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESmAEBxCJF14nio7EzhUo3Pi1LRS89PgUTXycp5xbuW8ln3CuAK9k1TEAeXhRZ2P2_3DxkwrtXukY04dvetpQW9e-A1aGasLEYrbHBGfFCqxUE8QYsjnvSUsPAse4m3V9e08ocle8lKw1GdKtSjZhcvwqVWOjWQepFzN61MKHX6jEKEdnjQ_0nPwLb9pjYDXdwbuM-aATuQoXZAw)[[5]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbAHEIkXXeP5YJeTjuEupRV2mYUns50N3Ltv2sZTUFq8mpHT3blVhm9j70G_JJQrjcgcL9G15e3pRvj7XtDU87pSHHJCMn2BP26PCTbD9vzjPdxSJies6V8b0hfCq_j6FX9tPo-m-xdCQCfT7SQ)[[6]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZgHEIkXXqJQs2NrDSlnhx-YjvbXE07xoJxpTr5ROVB31wGTwMAqUWGYe7BTknhKVOwOI8juxMt8u2Ajh3RSqTsYybex-yi7lb-pPGTgtkGD0cdSgFJhnId46E4rDxzcTUhqfaT6ldQ)[[7]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESiQEBxCJF18EpMviKuIXq4reR9u0u_a_Q_KFGYprpes2i0AUDB5Eskxvq4rRYTHPa9ybv5yqfPpTA7J2t18_2IhGhN1h1uB4LanrUjcD2U_Vemm9Gaw09af7Bn1dSukYMGM3-P0npvnxtw0BjKGgU5CUy4fxmvv_tH3VR2pFmvtW8fN1zBCBdH34owg)

### Key Effects and Considerations

- **Stomach and side effects:** Both azithromycin and alcohol can cause nausea, diarrhea, stomach pain, and dizziness. Combining them can make these side effects worse. Vomiting soon after a dose can also prevent your body from absorbing the full medication.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESawHEIkXXl6WjIZQqkcndR3Xi2tUHKakCT9we8kMckC14-t8m_TyIz-6GZoyoWV7Lh48_npj8wNEVUdjHUQ1S08sNLr5jDFD-uCVQhZJreGiqzI1IOO4PZxM2JtHZXwdbSGekk5lwigAdPuTT)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESiAEBxCJF1-FNY40WK5sb3zJPv_Jkf9adLYK2MQJ2_4ijwSc39KwXpge5lLSigyQfhpvkJUo5wmn3Y-H-Bm-_Bp8dJ-agvUzt7-a0FbZ6NaWuOhB9Q7JWoXE2KFsvlP6xB6vPTVuvAkb6Kh69oMmMEuLUSqX6sbqLip7zo0oyBmzqwp1mDpzsHDhM)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESggEBxCJF1w9yXu1VNbYysIy5kmlziTWvKaTjPgqdBcTVAGMKd1LDtIhHoW-TgBPOygHBEBRlUZammcK2__PSZC3nzKxItkConaEUdk6oshfHB-YfZ1GAxtkrV1s2hJqP5x78VghaEiVT4hS9w8zFHog0Mf4zxfBG8ixZg04FeO6fZk-r)
- **Liver workload:** Both alcohol and azithromycin are processed by the liver. Heavy or frequent drinking puts extra strain on the liver.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESiAEBxCJF1-FNY40WK5sb3zJPv_Jkf9adLYK2MQJ2_4ijwSc39KwXpge5lLSigyQfhpvkJUo5wmn3Y-H-Bm-_Bp8dJ-agvUzt7-a0FbZ6NaWuOhB9Q7JWoXE2KFsvlP6xB6vPTVuvAkb6Kh69oMmMEuLUSqX6sbqLip7zo0oyBmzqwp1mDpzsHDhM)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbAHEIkXXeP5YJeTjuEupRV2mYUns50N3Ltv2sZTUFq8mpHT3blVhm9j70G_JJQrjcgcL9G15e3pRvj7XtDU87pSHHJCMn2BP26PCTbD9vzjPdxSJies6V8b0hfCq_j6FX9tPo-m-xdCQCfT7SQ)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESggEBxCJF1w9yXu1VNbYysIy5kmlziTWvKaTjPgqdBcTVAGMKd1LDtIhHoW-TgBPOygHBEBRlUZammcK2__PSZC3nzKxItkConaEUdk6oshfHB-YfZ1GAxtkrV1s2hJqP5x78VghaEiVT4hS9w8zFHog0Mf4zxfBG8ixZg04FeO6fZk-r)[[4]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESawHEIkXXl6WjIZQqkcndR3Xi2tUHKakCT9we8kMckC14-t8m_TyIz-6GZoyoWV7Lh48_npj8wNEVUdjHUQ1S08sNLr5jDFD-uCVQhZJreGiqzI1IOO4PZxM2JtHZXwdbSGekk5lwigAdPuTT)
- **Recovery and immune health:** Alcohol disrupts sleep, increases dehydration, and can dampen immune function. This can slow down your recovery while your body fights an infection.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESawHEIkXXl6WjIZQqkcndR3Xi2tUHKakCT9we8kMckC14-t8m_TyIz-6GZoyoWV7Lh48_npj8wNEVUdjHUQ1S08sNLr5jDFD-uCVQhZJreGiqzI1IOO4PZxM2JtHZXwdbSGekk5lwigAdPuTT)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbAHEIkXXeP5YJeTjuEupRV2mYUns50N3Ltv2sZTUFq8mpHT3blVhm9j70G_JJQrjcgcL9G15e3pRvj7XtDU87pSHHJCMn2BP26PCTbD9vzjPdxSJies6V8b0hfCq_j6FX9tPo-m-xdCQCfT7SQ)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZgHEIkXXqJQs2NrDSlnhx-YjvbXE07xoJxpTr5ROVB31wGTwMAqUWGYe7BTknhKVOwOI8juxMt8u2Ajh3RSqTsYybex-yi7lb-pPGTgtkGD0cdSgFJhnId46E4rDxzcTUhqfaT6ldQ)
- **Waiting after treatment:** Because there is no direct drug-alcohol interaction, many sources note light drinking is low risk for healthy adults, though some clinicians suggest waiting until you finish your course and feel better—or waiting around 48 hours after your last dose if you prefer to let levels drop further.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEScgHEIkXXzB_rRwb5kG8nkHNUyq5ktO2xRPFJwwrokca8djG7qRzvC41gmjN0VB45frY1y_Vs4zdN0yZ9zzh7iVgpIS-kr1b7PKLFViVYnjGI-8FrgWeTRA4aHtS8ue5yM1FXf04UpCfSXQJgwAGCdgg0wQ)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESqQEBxCJF19CA2Ui5mgj9siI58XAhMNsna7T7vxwjReMJUiVtWEdohCaAnmjQRtXLeCTFeoVubGJ2My7rCUvqxmVsHbuo1nkuNfNEA0PGpdlXyXsEiD66TopZkkK6gVUGUoqx8AKJOdfAo1ndepXBgHaceEKi9evQi8cM7iZ4z_QPGgfyb-1BLGs78wXHmfY9BMlH9nJzweRQf-e0O7S2TA1MW5wBMRKpg-tI)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESmgEBxCJF19FlZ30uGuD8WNX9Iku13pPpQHd9Wi0KndJc0DuvetJ-P8MEFEIj3WJSidp-Z8SAsyZnWaZkfIlDsnuLMokocJaNAg35oZzmQiYktYZ8MoM_calu_SI5tlm4vcGLw37VGKjM7wI8FixOon44gwEBayrk1WWT9kcvW1_pAUvnlN6uOtawbpw23Zp_e9xaodi3ksf5nY5I)[[4]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESmAEBxCJF14nio7EzhUo3Pi1LRS89PgUTXycp5xbuW8ln3CuAK9k1TEAeXhRZ2P2_3DxkwrtXukY04dvetpQW9e-A1aGasLEYrbHBGfFCqxUE8QYsjnvSUsPAse4m3V9e08ocle8lKw1GdKtSjZhcvwqVWOjWQepFzN61MKHX6jEKEdnjQ_0nPwLb9pjYDXdwbuM-aATuQoXZAw)

Always finish your full prescribed course of azithromycin even if your symptoms improve early. If you have liver issues, heart rhythm concerns, or take other medications, check with a doctor or pharmacist before drinking.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESiQEBxCJF18EpMviKuIXq4reR9u0u_a_Q_KFGYprpes2i0AUDB5Eskxvq4rRYTHPa9ybv5yqfPpTA7J2t18_2IhGhN1h1uB4LanrUjcD2U_Vemm9Gaw09af7Bn1dSukYMGM3-P0npvnxtw0BjKGgU5CUy4fxmvv_tH3VR2pFmvtW8fN1zBCBdH34owg)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESiAEBxCJF1-FNY40WK5sb3zJPv_Jkf9adLYK2MQJ2_4ijwSc39KwXpge5lLSigyQfhpvkJUo5wmn3Y-H-Bm-_Bp8dJ-agvUzt7-a0FbZ6NaWuOhB9Q7JWoXE2KFsvlP6xB6vPTVuvAkb6Kh69oMmMEuLUSqX6sbqLip7zo0oyBmzqwp1mDpzsHDhM)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESqQEBxCJF19CA2Ui5mgj9siI58XAhMNsna7T7vxwjReMJUiVtWEdohCaAnmjQRtXLeCTFeoVubGJ2My7rCUvqxmVsHbuo1nkuNfNEA0PGpdlXyXsEiD66TopZkkK6gVUGUoqx8AKJOdfAo1ndepXBgHaceEKi9evQi8cM7iZ4z_QPGgfyb-1BLGs78wXHmfY9BMlH9nJzweRQf-e0O7S2TA1MW5wBMRKpg-tI)If you'd like to share **how far along you are in your course**, **any symptoms you're having** , or **other medications you take** , I can give more tailored information.

items.text: Stomach and side effects: Both azithromycin and alcohol can cause nausea, diarrhea, stomach pain, and dizziness. Combining them can make these side effects worse. Vomiting soon after a dose can also prevent your body from absorbing the full medication. Liver workload: Both alcohol and azithromycin are processed by the liver. This can slow down your recovery while your body fights an infection. - **Waiting after treatment:** Because there is no direct drug-alcohol interaction, many sources note light drinking is low risk for healthy adults, though some clinicians suggest waiting until you finish your course and feel better—or waiting around 48 hours after your last dose if you prefer to let levels drop further.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEScgHEIkXXzB_rRwb5kG8nkHNUyq5ktO2xRPFJwwrokca8djG7qRzvC41gmjN0VB45frY1y_Vs4zdN0yZ9zzh7iVgpIS-kr1b7PKLFViVYnjGI-8FrgWeTRA4aHtS8ue5yM1FXf04UpCfSXQJgwAGCdgg0wQ)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESqQEBxCJF19CA2Ui5mgj9siI58XAhMNsna7T7vxwjReMJUiVtWEdohCaAnmjQRtXLeCTFeoVubGJ2My7rCUvqxmVsHbuo1nkuNfNEA0PGpdlXyXsEiD66TopZkkK6gVUGUoqx8AKJOdfAo1ndepXBgHaceEKi9evQi8cM7iZ4z_QPGgfyb-1BLGs78wXHmfY9BMlH9nJzweRQf-e0O7S2TA1MW5wBMRKpg-tI)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESmgEBxCJF19FlZ30uGuD8WNX9Iku13pPpQHd9Wi0KndJc0DuvetJ-P8MEFEIj3WJSidp-Z8SAsyZnWaZkfIlDsnuLMokocJaNAg35oZzmQiYktYZ8MoM_calu_SI5tlm4vcGLw37VGKjM7wI8FixOon44gwEBayrk1WWT9kcvW1_pAUvnlN6uOtawbpw23Zp_e9xaodi3ksf5nY5I)[[4]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESmAEBxCJF14nio7EzhUo3Pi1LRS89PgUTXycp5xbuW8ln3CuAK9k1TEAeXhRZ2P2_3DxkwrtXukY04dvetpQW9e-A1aGasLEYrbHBGfFCqxUE8QYsjnvSUsPAse4m3V9e08ocle8lKw1GdKtSjZhcvwqVWOjWQepFzN61MKHX6jEKEdnjQ_0nPwLb9pjYDXdwbuM-aATuQoXZAw)
